name: CSV tools
summary: A NextOS Extension that opens any .csv file as a sortable table, straight from a Finder context action.

seo.title: CSV tools - a NextOS Extension example
seo.description: Open any .csv as a sortable table from Finder or the Preview pane - a small extension: a context action, a file handler, a preview renderer, one panel.

faq.a: Four things: a Finder context action ("Open as table") on .csv files, a file handler that opens the same table panel, a preview renderer so Finder's Preview pane shows the parsed table instead of raw text, and the panel itself (panels/table.html, a sandboxed webview).

faq.q: What permission does it ask for?
faq.a: fs:read:home, so its worker code can read the .csv file the panel is opened for. It writes nothing and reaches no network.
